chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Ja'far, from his father, from Ali (peace be upon him)
that whenever he arrived in Makkah, he would begin with his house before he circumambulated.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali do first when he arrived in Makkah?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights Imam Ali’s (AS) specific Sunnah of visiting his residence in Makkah before performing Tawaf, reflecting the historical significance of his family's dwelling place near the Kaaba. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on honoring the Ahl al-Bayt’s physical presence and legacy within the holy sanctuary, distinguishing their devotional etiquette from general customs.
